// diagnostic

E0202

This change needs write access the place doesn't have

What

This change needs write access the place doesn't have

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Declare the parameter or receiver with the write mark `&` (`x: &T`, `&self`), or bind the value with `:=` first.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0202: tests/ui/iter_cursor_immutable_binding.stderr.

Error [jet.MissingWriteMarker]: `.next()` changes `cur`, which has read access only
  --> tests/ui/iter_cursor_immutable_binding.jet:20:12
    |
 20 |     a: cur.next()
    |            ^^^^
 Why: This method edits the value it's called on, so its receiver needs write access
 Fix: Declare `cur := ...`
